messages:
Maya (AE): LumenBank wants a 10-day POC for SSO+SCIM with strict domain controls and RBAC by brand. They asked for proof of SAML message encryption and SCIM delta support.
Leo (SE): We support SAML2 (IdP/SP initiated), optional encrypted RelayState and encrypted assertions. SCIM v2 delta and bulk import supported.
Priya (Prod): Need to confirm group-to-role mapping and whether nested roles are required for their org.
Maya (AE): They do want nested roles (global-admin > regional-admin > product-admin). Can we demo inheritance?
Leo (SE): Yes, we can map SCIM groups into role objects and show inheritance in mapping YAML during the demo.
Mark (Pricing): Preliminary: POC support + reserved Dedicated (low tier) = $10k/mo; Private EU residency uplift = +$5k/mo. Final quote after sizing.
sec-bot: Security checklist created: https://redwood.in/sec/q/1998000000 - items: SAML encryption options, SCIM bulk/delta scope, audit retention, KMS integration.
Maya (AE): Action items: Leo to send SAML metadata and SCIM examples; Mark to draft POC quote; follow-up Wednesday to lock schedule.
thread_text_preview: LumenBank POC: SAML encryption, SCIM delta+bulk, nested RBAC mapping, Dedicated vs Private pricing, EU residency checklist
